about.title: About LoopLoopTech
about.lead: We are a company focused on warehouse, lab and smart community digitization. The two loops in our name capture everything we believe about software: systems should run in loops, and products should evolve in loops.

sections.title: What we believe
sections.desc: Great enterprise software should not be an expensive custom project. It should be a public service that works out of the box and gets smarter with use. We keep the hard engineering on the platform, and hand simple certainty to our customers.

sections.title: How we work
sections.desc: A small team, long cycles, engineering-driven. We do not stack features on a roadmap — we remove real friction from real operations. Every iteration is validated in warehouses and labs run by our partners first.

items.title: Restraint
items.desc: Subtract features, add reliability.

items.title: Professional
items.desc: Polish every detail to professional standards.

items.title: Long-term
items.desc: Partner with customers in decades.

contact.title: Tell us about your business
contact.desc: Whether it is one lab, one warehouse, or a supply chain network across continents — we would love to hear your story.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: LoopLoopTech ("we", "us") understands how important your personal information is. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, share and protect information when you use our website and products such as WMS, LIMS and ICMS, and the rights you have.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to the LoopLoopTech website (www.looplooptech.com) and our software services, including WMS, LIMS and ICMS.

Where your organization is our customer, we generally act as a data processor and handle data in your business systems on the customer's instructions, as governed by our data processing agreement. This policy also describes our general security practices in that role.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We follow the principle of data minimization and collect only what is necessary to provide our services:
bullets: Account and contact information: name, company, email address, phone number;
Usage and log information: sign-in time, IP address, browser and device type, activity records;
Communication information: details you provide when booking a demo or contacting support;
Cookies and similar technologies: used to keep you signed in and remember your language and theme preferences;
Anonymous usage analytics: page views and navigation events collected through Aptabase without cookies, device identifiers or persistent user identification.

sections.title: How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect only for the purposes below, and not for unrelated purposes; if we ever need to use it beyond this policy, we will ask for your consent:
bullets: Provide, maintain and improve our products and services;
Authenticate accounts, provide support and troubleshoot;
Keep services secure and prevent fraud and abuse;
Send service notices, security alerts and, with your consent, product updates;

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and to protect the service, and preference cookies to remember your language and theme choices.
Website analytics is provided by Aptabase and does not use cookies or similar storage; the data cannot be used to identify you personally.
You can manage or delete cookies in your browser settings; disabling essential cookies may affect some features.

sections.title: Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only in these cases:
bullets: With your explicit consent or authorization;
With service providers acting on our instructions (such as cloud hosting, analytics, email and SMS providers), who may process it only as we direct;
When required by law or by a lawful request from a judicial or administrative authority;
As part of a merger, acquisition or asset transfer, where we will notify you in advance and require the recipient to honor this policy.

sections.title: Storage and Security
paragraphs: We protect your information with technical and organizational measures including encryption in transit and at rest, fine-grained access control and audit logs.
We keep personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: International Transfers
paragraphs: Our services may use cloud infrastructure in different regions. Where personal information is transferred outside your jurisdiction, we comply with applicable law, for example by obtaining consent or entering into standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, you may access, copy, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, withdraw consent, or close your account.
You can exercise these rights by writing to info@looplooptech.com. We will respond within the period required by law.

sections.title: Minors
paragraphs: Our products and services are built for businesses and organizations, not for minors. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors and will delete it promptly if we learn we have.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. For material changes we will notify you by a notice on the website or by email, and update the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use our services means you accept the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions, comments or complaints about this policy, contact us at info@looplooptech.com.
